name: split-document
commonDescription:
Splits text into overlapping segments for language-model tokenisation. The segment and overlap sizes are
estimated token counts.
commonReturnDescription: An array of text segments, or an empty array if splitting fails.

args.description: The target segment size in estimated tokens.
args.name: segmentSize

args.description: The overlap between adjacent segments in estimated tokens.
args.name: overlapSize
